sources.title: Greenhouse gas emission intensity of electricity generation in Europe (indicator ENER038)
sources.licence: CC BY (version not stated) under the EEA legal notice (https://www.eea.europa.eu/en/legal-notice): re-use, including commercial, with the EEA acknowledged in each copy and the meaning not distorted
sources.attribution: Source: European Environment Agency (EEA), indicator ENER038 'Greenhouse gas emission intensity of electricity generation in Europe' (2026), https://www.eea.europa.eu/en/analysis/indicators/greenhouse-gas-emission-intensity-of-1, CC BY; values converted from g to kg CO2e per kWh.
sources.method: GWP100 of the UNFCCC inventories (IPCC AR5 for 2023+ submissions; not stated by the indicator)
sources.notes: Ratio of CO2e emissions from electricity production to gross electricity generation, nuclear and renewables included at zero (indicator methodology). The numerator is inventory category 1A1a (public electricity and heat), scaled up for autoproducers by their energy input, with heat split out pro rata. Biomass combustion (as CO2e, not only CO2) and upstream emissions are not included. Per kWh of gross generation: plants' own use, T&D losses and imports are not counted, so per kWh delivered the intensity would be higher. Country values are published as integers (g). Underlying data: inventories reported to UNFCCC, Eurostat nrg_bal_c. checksum is of the EU-27 file; country file sha256:0a2668e4d109ca83e62412b94e987df6f5dce967fcc3616d602979b57eb9866e.
